Soft pieces

Fish with broccoli and kohlrabi

Hal brokkolival és karalábéval

8 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Flake the fish and mash any firm piece. Kohlrabi should crush completely before it is served.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 140 g boneless cod or hake (fillet, bones checked)
  • 100 g broccoli (small florets)
  • 80 g kohlrabi (peeled and diced very small)
  • 60 g small pasta (dry weight)
  • 10 g mild hard cheese (pasteurized, finely grated)
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 300 ml water (for cooking the vegetables)

Allergens

fishglutenmilk

Method

  1. Peel and finely dice the kohlrabi, then cook it in the water until a piece crushes easily.
  2. Add the broccoli and cook until it is soft.
  3. Lay the fish in the pan and poach it until it flakes, then check every flake and remove any bone.
  4. Boil the pasta in unsalted water until very soft, then drain it.
  5. Toss the fish, vegetables, pasta, cheese, and oil, and mash any piece that does not squash.

Adjusted

Kohlrabi is fibrous if it is undercooked, and any missed bone makes the fish unsafe. A large amount of cheese would also be too salty.

Cook boneless fish, broccoli, and kohlrabi until very soft, and check the flakes for bones. Use only a little pasteurized cheese with small pasta, and mash anything the baby cannot chew.
